listOfItemDatabase.name: Throwing Daggers
listOfItemDatabase.description: These daggers can be used as a ranged attack. While they do only 60% of the player's current attack power as damage, they ignore the target's defense.

listOfItemDatabase.name: Small Rune Bomb
listOfItemDatabase.description: When throw, these magic concotions will react and blow up on contact with any surface. This explosive force deals around 150 flat damage.

listOfItemDatabase.name: Dash
listOfItemDatabase.description:
This skill gives you a short boost of speed and allows you to phase through enemies and projectiles. This means that it can be used for both fast movement and dodging.

Spirit Cost: 20

listOfItemDatabase.name: Sliding Tackle
listOfItemDatabase.description:
A versatile skill that can be used to stagger vulnerable enemies, dodge under projectles or to reach certain areas that require sliding into tight passages.

Spirit Cost: 30

listOfItemDatabase.name: Invincibility Shield
listOfItemDatabase.description:
Maya becomes invulnerable while under the protection of the shield, allowing her to fight without worry or to be able to move safely through dangerous areas.

Spirit Cost: 50

listOfItemDatabase.name: Flame Sword
listOfItemDatabase.description:
Can be used as an offensive tool to deal with airborne enemies, or as a means of additional vertical movement in order to reach new heights.

Spirit Cost: 30

listOfItemDatabase.name: Power Slash
listOfItemDatabase.description:
A strong attack skill that can tear through enemies in a straight line, can be also used while in the air.

Spirit Cost: 70

listOfItemDatabase.name: Crimson Scepter
listOfItemDatabase.description: An ominous, blood-colored scepter adorned with golden details. This artifact allows Maya to teleport at will to previously visited save points.
